effects.description: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] Give up to 1 rested DON!! card to your Leader or 1 of your Characters.
conditions: You have at least 1 rested DON!! card
You have not used this effect yet this turn
steps: Attach it to your Leader or 1 of your Characters
notes: You can choose not to use this effect even if all conditions are met
This effect can only be used once per turn
The DON!! card must be rested when attaching
